ClearFeed

what's the dream role you've been thinking about?
Right now I'm basically looking for something new. It should be in the domain of AI for sure. And possibly remote work.

ai domain + remote... smart move. everyone's throwing around "ai engineer" these days but the good remote ai roles? those are actually rare and worth fighting for.

btw, is that linkedin profile i found actually you? need to confirm before we dive deeper into what kind of ai work gets you excited.
Yeah that's me, but haven't really updated my LinkedIn profile in quite a while

mts at clearfeed... building the ai that makes customer support actually bearable. bet you've seen some wild slack chaos in your time there. what made you want to jump into the broader ai space? getting tired of just support automation or is there something bigger calling?

founding engineer to "i know everything end to end" is the classic startup trap. you built the thing, now you're maintaining it, and your brain is basically on autopilot. that nvidia deep learning cert from 2021 is calling your name.

how long you been working total? trying to figure out if you're ready for senior ai roles or if we need to find something that lets you level up while you learn.

I've been working overall for 2.5 years full time.
If you counter internship it would've been almost 3.75 years. 
Also for AI role, I'm not necessarily looking for AI engineering roles. I still want to stick to Full Stack part of the AI. And I want to still build products that actually solve a problem for users

ah, the full stack ai product builder. respect. you don't want to be the person training models in isolation - you want to be the one shipping ai features that users actually care about.

2.5 years + founding engineer experience... you're in that sweet spot where you can handle real responsibility but still hungry to learn. full stack ai product roles are actually perfect for someone with your background.

what kind of role you looking for next? thinking like ai product engineer, full stack developer at ai companies, or something else entirely?
Full stack developer or even AI product engineer should work

full stack developer or ai product engineer... both solid choices for someone who wants to ship actual products, not just fiddle with models all day.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
It's either Bangalore. Or remote. For remote I wouldn't want an Indian company

bangalore or remote with international companies... smart filter. indian remote usually means "remote until we need you in office" anyway.

so let me get this straight: 2.5 years experience + full stack developer or ai product engineer roles + bangalore or remote (international companies only)... sound right?

Yeah. For Bangalore companies, I want to avoid some very early stage startups. Basically I'm not looking for Indian founders, especially first time Indian Founders. An Indian founder works of this is not his first time. And if the company itself is outside India

ahh the founder filter. been burned by the "we'll figure it out as we go" energy? totally get it.

so experienced indian founders or international companies only. makes sense - you want someone who's done this dance before, not learning on your time.

updated summary: 2.5 years experience + full stack developer or ai product engineer + bangalore (experienced founders/international cos) or remote international... that's the target?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

yooo welcome to the tal network! 

you're officially in the system. i'll be sliding quality ai roles your way - the kind where experienced founders actually know what they're building and international companies that won't waste your time.
